author: Neuralink
description:
To celebrate GTA VI release day, Billy used his Neuralink implant to play the game during an internal livestream.

As a Neuralink study participant living with tetraplegia due to spinal cord injury, he has been working with our engineers to explore new ways of controlling devices like a computer, phone, and robotic arm telepathically. 

For playing video games, he’s demonstrated the ability to use 2 joysticks and 12 buttons, all with his mind, without a physical controller.

With his permission, we’re sharing a recording of the livestream here.

Chapters
00:00 - Cruising in a boat
03:10 - Operation sneak around
07:30 - Shooting and fighting
10:40 - Flying the sea plane
14:40 - Driving a car
17:20 - Closing thoughts

Neuralink devices are investigational and have not been approved by the FDA or other regulatory authorities. This content features voluntary clinical trial participants sharing their personal experiences, which may not reflect all participants or future outcomes.
title: Using Telepathy To Play GTA VI | Neuralink
